review_comments.body:
Optional, not a blocker, and not caused by this PR. The rebuilt class now accepts the tuple, but it does not always score like the original. I measured on this head, comparing two identical values with `ComparableField()` and the default `LevenshteinComparator`:

| Field | Original class | Rebuilt by `model_from_json()` |
|---|---|---|
| `Tuple[str, int]` | 0.0 | 1.0 |
| `Optional[Tuple[int, int]]` | 0.0 | 1.0 |
| `Tuple[float, ...]` | 0.0 | 1.0 |
| `Tuple[float, float, float, float]` with `BBoxIoUComparator` | same | same |

The hand-written class gives 0.0 on `dev` too, so this is the tuple scoring tracked in #391, not the export. It may be worth linking #391 from #636, so nobody reads a working round trip as matching scores.
